sources.title: Cross-Modal Model Merging
sources.snippet: This synthesis demonstrates that cross-modal model merging is a core problem at the intersection of deep learning, multimodal fusion, and model compression, with a rapidly expanding methodology suite designed to robustly exploit multimodal signals, transfer specialist expertise, and underpin next-generation unified AI systems.
